g.text: Score sheet C is kept separate; no dimension score was changed by adjudication
Bars show means on the original 0-2 scale; dots show each task rating. No fabricated error bars or significance tests.
These are descriptive scores of prepared-input development configurations, not knockdown accuracy or user-experience measurements.
